- HARDENING_SUGGESTION
  File: scripts/check_failure_triage.sh
  Location: Lines 330-340 (Claude execution path)
  Issue: The Claude execution path lacks the `CODEX_STALL_GUARD_HELPER` wrapper that other scripts (e.g., `review_apply_fixes.sh`, `review_consolidate.sh`) use for long-running model calls. A stalled Claude CLI can keep the CI job active until the global timeout.
  Suggested minimal fix: Wrap the Claude call with the stall guard when available, matching the pattern in `review_apply_fixes.sh`:
```bash
if [ -x "${CODEX_STALL_GUARD_HELPER}" ]; then
  "${CODEX_STALL_GUARD_HELPER}" --phase check_failure_triage --engine claude \
    --stdout-file "${DIAG_FILE}" -- bash -c 'source "$1" && claude_run_selected CHECK_TRIAGE "$2" "$3" "$4"' _ \
    "${triage_engine_sh}" "${PROMPT_FILE}" "${DIAG_FILE}" "${PWD}" || triage_claude_rc=$?
else
  # existing Claude call
fi
```
  Estimated lines changed: 8
